description: This file is a shell script defining an API and utility functions for managing services with the 'procd' initialization system. It includes functions to open, close, and manipulate service configurations, trigger management, and signaling, primarily through JSON encoding and ubus calls.

methods.name: procd_open_service
methods.description: Initialize a new service with optional script.

methods.name: procd_close_service
methods.description: Finalize and send the service configuration.

methods.name: procd_open_instance
methods.description: Add a new instance to the current service.

methods.name: procd_running
methods.description: Check if a specific service instance is running.

methods.name: procd_kill
methods.description: Kill a specific service or instance.

methods.name: procd_send_signal
methods.description: Send a signal to a service instance.

methods.name: procd_status
methods.description: Get the running status of a service or instance.

methods.name: procd_open_data
methods.description: Open data section for a service.

methods.name: procd_close_data
methods.description: Close data section for a service.

methods.name: procd_set_config_changed
methods.description: Notify that configuration has changed for a package.

methods.name: procd_add_mdns
methods.description: Add mDNS information to service data.
